Q (E4): does the webhook fire path ride the landed src/personalclaw/inbound/ substrate, or does EXTERNAL-ACCESS mint a new inbound surface? RULED: RIDE THE LANDED inbound/ SUBSTRATE. It already ships auth, capabilities, audit, mcp_http and tools. A second inbound surface would be two doors into the same house, each with its own auth and its own audit -- and the one that gets less attention becomes the way in. The scoped-token verification this atom needs is a capability on the existing door, not a new door. This also removes the EXT dependency the atom carried: nothing in EXTERNAL-ACCESS needs to land first. |
